label: concernsRisk
truthmaker_or_semantics: Information artifact is about/concerns a Risk pattern.
cardinality_property_decision: No global functionality; many records/descriptions may concern same Risk.
formalization_note: Object property/aboutness; preserve version context.

label: describesScenario
truthmaker_or_semantics: Scenario Description represents/describes a Risk Scenario.
formalization_note: Representation/aboutness relation.

label: realizedAs
truthmaker_or_semantics: Possible scenario type/pattern has a realized event occurrence.
formalization_note: Keep modal/type-to-occurrence semantics explicit; not simple subclass/equivalence.

label: hasConsequence
truthmaker_or_semantics: Event/scenario context results in or is associated with a Consequence situation.
formalization_note: Causal strength must be separated from generic outcome linkage.

label: hasRiskSource
truthmaker_or_semantics: Risk pattern identifies a source-role participant without asserting causation.
formalization_note: Use typed source refinements rather than universal RiskSource superclass restrictions.

label: predisposedBy
truthmaker_or_semantics: Predisposing Condition situation contributes susceptibility to scenario/event context.
formalization_note: Do not collapse to causes.

label: triggeredBy
truthmaker_or_semantics: Risk Event is triggered by a Trigger event under a context.
formalization_note: Can be subproperty/refinement of causal relation only if #26 evidence supports.

label: causes
truthmaker_or_semantics: Causal dependence between occurrences/situations has an evidential/contextual truthmaker.
formalization_note: Keep provenance/evidence for asserted causal links.

label: associatedWith
truthmaker_or_semantics: Represents an evidence-bound association/dependency claim, not ontological causation.
cardinality_property_decision: No global symmetry because directed dependency use also exists.
formalization_note: Prefer reified/provenanced assertion or split generic association vs dependency in #26.

label: affects
truthmaker_or_semantics: Risk/Event/Consequence changes or bears on external subject/objective/capability/process context.
formalization_note: Potential vs realized effect may be profiled.

label: exposes
truthmaker_or_semantics: Exposure Situation provides truthmaking context connecting subject and source.
formalization_note: May be derived through Exposure situation participation.

label: hasVulnerability
truthmaker_or_semantics: Vulnerability disposition inheres in/characterizes its bearer.
formalization_note: Align to gufo:inheresIn/characterization pattern rather than invent generic association.

label: performedAssessmentOf
truthmaker_or_semantics: Assessment event targets/concerns a Risk pattern/context.
cardinality_property_decision: Minimum one target is application SHACL candidate, not universal OWL truth yet.
formalization_note: Keep event target/aboutness explicit.

label: usesAssessmentMethod
truthmaker_or_semantics: Assessment event follows/uses method specification.
formalization_note: Participation/use relation; local constraints in SHACL.

label: producesAssessmentResult
truthmaker_or_semantics: Assessment Result is generated by/historically depends on assessment event.
cardinality_property_decision: A result should have generating assessment locally; OWL exact cardinality not precommitted.
formalization_note: Align to creation/generation provenance pattern.

label: assessmentResultConcerns
truthmaker_or_semantics: Assessment Result is about Risk/context.
formalization_note: Information-object aboutness.

label: supportedByEvidence
truthmaker_or_semantics: Evidence role provides support/challenge for an assertion/result in context.
formalization_note: Prefer qualified/reified support relation with provenance.

label: generatedByObservation
truthmaker_or_semantics: Observation Result is generated by an Observation Activity.
formalization_note: Generation/provenance relation.

label: hasProvenance
truthmaker_or_semantics: Artifact/result/assertion participates in PROV-O derivation/attribution/generation structures.
formalization_note: Reuse PROV-O predicates; avoid local generic Provenance individual if unnecessary.

label: qualifiedByConfidence
truthmaker_or_semantics: Assessment/evidence artifact is qualified by method-specific confidence/uncertainty information.
formalization_note: #26 may use quality/value or qualified annotation pattern.

label: selectsTreatmentStrategy
truthmaker_or_semantics: Risk-management context/record points to selected strategy information object.
formalization_note: If decision event is later modeled, strategy selection may be mediated by it.

label: planImplementsStrategy
truthmaker_or_semantics: Treatment Plan refines/implements chosen Strategy specification.
formalization_note: Aboutness/implementation relation, not part-whole.

label: activityExecutesPlan
truthmaker_or_semantics: Treatment Activity realizes/executes a Plan.
cardinality_property_decision: Many activities per plan; activity may serve multiple plan contexts only if explicit.
formalization_note: Plan realization relation.

label: activityUsesControl
truthmaker_or_semantics: Control bearer participates in Treatment Activity in control role.
formalization_note: Model bearer/control role participation; do not reify role individual.

label: controlProtects
truthmaker_or_semantics: An entity acting as Control Mechanism bears capability/role directed toward protected subject/context.
formalization_note: ROSE countermeasure/protection relations are narrower security refinements.

label: hasRiskOwner
truthmaker_or_semantics: Derived relation between Risk/managed record context and external Actor playing RiskOwner, truthmade by Risk Responsibility assignment.
formalization_note: Replace prior `bearsRiskOwnerRole` shorthand. RiskOwner is a type/role, not a role individual. Derive from relator mediation/aboutness.

label: assignsResponsibilityFor
truthmaker_or_semantics: Risk Responsibility relator/assignment is about the governed Risk and/or managed artifact/plan/obligation it concerns; Risk is an assignment/aboutness target, not a mediated endurant by convenience.
formalization_note: Under #71, mediation is reserved for endurant participants; the relational risk_id is a projection of responsibility-about-Risk.

label: responsibilityAssignedTo
truthmaker_or_semantics: Risk Responsibility mediates/depends on the Actor who bears the owner/responsible role and any other explicitly modeled endurant governance participants.
cardinality_property_decision: At least one assignee is a local constraint.
formalization_note: Align to gufo:mediates for endurant participants only; do not infer that the derived Risk pattern is a mediated relatum.

label: registerContainsEntry
truthmaker_or_semantics: Risk Register information collection has Risk Register Entry members.
cardinality_property_decision: Entries may move/version; no universal exactly-one register assumption.
formalization_note: Collection membership, not part-whole of Risk phenomena.

label: hasWorkflowState
truthmaker_or_semantics: Workflow-state quality/value characterizes a Risk Register Entry/application workflow representation.
cardinality_property_decision: One current status per scheme may be SHACL/application constraint, not universal ontology truth.
formalization_note: Use quality/value pattern.

label: hasRiskState
truthmaker_or_semantics: Risk pattern is contextualized by a time/context-bound Risk State situation. Management/workflow/monitoring classifications are excluded from this Core relation.
cardinality_property_decision: No global exactly-one; historical states coexist.
formalization_note: Time-indexed relation/pattern.

label: precedesState
truthmaker_or_semantics: Orders states within the same state dimension.
cardinality_property_decision: Transitivity may be inherited from chosen time ontology only, not asserted ad hoc.
formalization_note: Reuse OWL-Time/gUFO temporal relations if compatible.

label: supersedesAssessmentResult
truthmaker_or_semantics: New assessment result revises/supersedes earlier result while historical identity remains.
cardinality_property_decision: Do not make inverse-functional/transitive by default.
formalization_note: Prefer PROV revision/derivation pattern.

label: basedOnPriorAssessment
truthmaker_or_semantics: Reassessment activity/result uses earlier assessment/result as input/context.
cardinality_property_decision: Temporal precedence required but no universal transitivity.
formalization_note: Provenance/derivation pattern.

label: hasIndicator
truthmaker_or_semantics: Risk/process context identifies an Indicator specification used for monitoring.
formalization_note: Method/governance relation.

label: hasThreshold
truthmaker_or_semantics: Indicator/method/criteria specification contains or refers to method-specific threshold.
formalization_note: Closed-world/method profile home likely SHACL/rules/data.

label: pharmaEntityInRiskContext
truthmaker_or_semantics: Links SemRisk risk pattern to externally owned CM-PharmE entity without changing its category.
formalization_note: Mapping/profile relation; preserve CM-PharmE stereotypes.

label: profileExtendsCoreConcept
truthmaker_or_semantics: Registry/meta relation declaring profile refinement of a Core semantic concept.
formalization_note: Keep in mapping/governance metadata, not domain OWL unless #26 chooses metamodel layer.
